theorem balanceR_eq_balanceRErase {k : α} {v : β k} {l r : Impl α β} {hlb hrb hlr} :
    balanceR k v l r hlb hrb hlr = balanceRErase k v l r hlb hrb hlr.erase := by
  fun_cases balanceR <;>
    simp only [balanceRErase, ↓reduceDIte, ↓reduceIte, *]
